entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor planeswalker who has worked to strip Innistrad of its wards and calls Emrakul to the plane to avenge herself on Sorin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: The vampire planeswalker Nahiri vows to punish; Jace curses him for leaving a mess.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An enormous Eldrazi titan with a single magenta eye who rises from the sea off Innistrad and corrupts its inhabitants.

entities.name: Maeli
entities.description: A young boy who fled his burning village and is again threatened, this time by Ms. Sadie's transformed form, and prays to Avacyn.

entities.name: Ms. Sadie
aliases: the old woman with the gray hair
entities.description: An old woman who took Maeli in and burst into many arms at dinner.

entities.name: Edith
entities.description: A devout cultist who strives to be closest to Emrakul and is chosen as she rises.

entities.name: Hal
entities.description: A woman fighting corrupted townsfolk in the Ulvenwald alongside Alena, whom she loves.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: Hal's steady partner, who fights corrupted townsfolk in the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Elder Kolman
entities.description: A holy elder transformed into a monster that chants Emrakul's name, killed by Hal and Alena.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who resists Emrakul's touch with Tamiyo's help and goes to fetch the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker who teaches Jace to shield his mind and protects it so he can planeswalk away.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker friend of Jace who greets him on Zendikar.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker friend who told Jace to return to Zendikar if he heard news of the titan.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker with green eyes, one of Jace's friends.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The dead archangel whom Maeli prays to.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: An angel who is gone, subsumed into Emrakul's angel.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: An angel who is finished, subsumed into Emrakul's angel.

entities.name: Emrakul's Angel
entities.description: A fused angel with four wings, two arms, two heads and one voice that leads the faithful in proclaiming Emrakul.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane without a protector, now uprooting itself to follow Emrakul.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Jace returns to, where his friends are.

entities.name: The Ulvenwald
entities.description: A forest twisted into horror by Emrakul's influence.

entities.name: The Drownyard
entities.description: The ring of twisted stone pillars off the coast where Emrakul rises from the sea.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between worlds from which Nahiri calls Emrakul.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Jace's group of planeswalker allies.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Armed soldiers who guard Maeli and cut Ms. Sadie's arms.

entities.name: Emrakul's Cultists
entities.description: Worshippers who chant at the Drownyard and are warped into Emrakul's likeness.

events.summary: Innistrad's final ward falls and the plane is left naked and vulnerable.
events.quote: Innistrad's final ward had fallen.

events.summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
events.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

events.summary: Nahiri sees the temple she constructed for the god no longer empty.
events.quote: To the temple she had constructed for the god. It was no longer empty.

events.summary: Maeli, guarded by cathars, remembers fleeing his burning village as his mother ordered.
events.quote: He had run into the forest like his mother had told him, and he had not gone back to the village.

events.summary: Ms. Sadie's chest bursts open into many arms at dinner and she chases Maeli.
events.quote: the same writhing arms that had burst out of Ms. Sadie's chest that very night while they ate their dinner

events.summary: The cathars slice off Ms. Sadie's grasping arms.
events.quote: The cathars shifted in the tall grass, slicing off one arm after another.

events.summary: Maeli prays to Avacyn, who is dead, for help.
events.quote: PLEASE, AVACYN! HELP ME!

events.summary: A mad angel announces that Emrakul is rising and dives at Maeli.
events.quote: She dove down, her blade slicing through the air ahead of her.

events.summary: Edith, in a crowd of cultists, begs to be chosen as Emrakul rises.
events.quote: Choose me! Me! Me'mrakul.

events.summary: Emrakul rises from the sea at the Drownyard.
events.quote: And then Emrakul rose.

events.summary: Emrakul looks upon Edith, who feels chosen.
events.quote: She looked down at Edith with one enormous, glowing magenta eye.

events.summary: Hal and Alena stand back to back in a nightmarish grove of the Ulvenwald, surrounded by corrupted townsfolk.
events.quote: They were in a grove in the Ulvenwald, but the Ulvenwald was not the woods they had known.

events.summary: Hal recognizes one monster as Elder Kolman.
events.quote: Elder Kolman. May the angel save him.

events.summary: Alena's touch pulls Hal back as she nearly succumbs to the chanting.
events.quote: It was Alena's touch, her sweating fingers gripping Hal's wrist, that yanked Hal away from the suffocating embrace.

events.summary: Hal and Alena together kill the transformed Elder Kolman.
events.quote: Hal swung again, beheading the once-holy man.

events.summary: Hal and Alena flee the grove, running until they can no longer hear the chanting.
events.quote: They ran until they could no longer hear the chanting, until they could no longer feel the pressure in their heads.

events.summary: Bruna and Gisela are gone, becoming one fused angel that proclaims Emrakul.
events.quote: Emrakul's angel parted four wings, reached out with two arms, and cried with a single voice that sprang from two mouths

events.summary: Emrakul's angel leads the faithful below in a chorus of We are Emrakul.
events.quote: Emrakul's angel led all below in following Her radiant form.

events.summary: Jace, shielding his mind with Tamiyo's teaching, is distracted by the warped angel overhead.
events.quote: This time it had been the sight of the warped angel in the sky overhead that had distracted Jace.

events.summary: Jace recalls Gideon told him to return to Zendikar if he heard of a titan.
events.quote: Gideon himself had told Jace to come back to Zendikar if he heard news of the titan.

events.summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
events.quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

events.summary: Jace asks Emrakul her name and is flooded with words of conquest.
events.quote: The beginning—I shall be all.

events.summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
events.quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

events.summary: Tamiyo refuses to come with Jace, saying that is not her path.
events.quote: No, Jace. That's not my path.

events.summary: Tamiyo shields Jace's mind so that he can planeswalk away.
events.quote: I will protect your mind so you can planeswalk

events.summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
events.quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

relations.note: Hal looks up at the woman she loves.
relations.quote: She looked up at the woman she loved.

relations.note: She cleaves the monster's head in two.
relations.quote: she cleaved the elder's head in two

relations.note: She teaches him to resist Emrakul's touch.
relations.quote: Tamiyo had taught him how to combat Emrakul's maddening touch
She had proven that she was devout.

relations.note: She calls Emrakul to Innistrad and built a temple for her.
relations.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

relations.note: She keeps her vow of vengeance.
relations.quote: As I have wept, so will Sorin.

relations.note: She took him in before transforming and chasing him.
relations.quote: She had told him to call her Ms. Sadie, and said that her house could be his house for as long as he wanted.

relations.note: Jace plans to bring Gideon and his friends to help.
relations.quote: for Gideon and Chandra and Nissa
